title: Core GFS and GEFS Local MOS Experts
mission: Train deterministic GFS MOS and probabilistic GEFS MOS on the strict modern core frame, including expected-error outputs.
inputs: official and target labels behind research role
steps: Train GFS residual-to-HKO MOS using trajectory, spatial and vertical features.
Train GEFS conditional median/quantiles and residual calibration.
Train expected absolute-error models for both experts.
Use nested expanding folds and model-version features.
Compare direct, simple bias, linear MOS, GAM and boosting.
db_objects: research GFS/GEFS model artifacts and OOF predictions
acceptance: MOS beats direct model or is rejected
GEFS distribution calibrated enough for router/distribution layer
failure: Historical availability grade below B: results labeled diagnostic-proxy, not strict champion
